config.notes: Two page kinds. (1) Handbook pages handbook.jcu.edu.au/course/<year>/<id> (CourseLoop): print Type (study level), AQF Level, Location (campus), Expected time to complete (duration), CRICOS Code. They carry no start dates and no fees; English is usually only "Band 1/2/3 - Schedule II of the JCU Admissions Policy" (central: https://www.jcu.edu.au/policy/academic-governance/student-experience/admissions-policy-schedule-ii, Band 1 = IELTS 6.0 no band below 6.0, Band 2 = 6.5 no band below 6.0, Band 3a = 7.0 no band below 6.5); a few print an explicit course IELTS, read by ielts_overall. (2) Course pages www.jcu.edu.au/courses/<slug>: Fast Facts "Commencing <campus>: <months>" (intakes) and "Estimated annual tuition fee: $X Courses are charged per year of full-time study. International course fees..." (international annual fee only; CSP and unlabelled tuition fees are not read). Trimesters 2026 (https://www.jcu.edu.au/students/academic-calendars/academic-calendars-2026/Trimesters.pdf): T1 begins late January, T2 May, T3 September; pages print months, so no term_months.
